import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
files = sorted(p for root in ('products/distribution', 'products/services', 'products/reviews') for p in Path(root).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.json', '.md', '.py', '.diff') and p.stat().st_size <= 262144)
markers = ('price-update-review-en', 'price-update-review-fr', '518a7843922faae2a1638530e4e59234524e81ab7496c34324e644ab6b4fc5eb')
matches = []
for path in files:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    found = [marker for marker in markers if marker.encode() in data]
    named = bool(re.search(r'(price[-_/]update|price[-_/]review|price[-_/]change)', path.as_posix(), re.I))
    if found or named:
        matches.append({'path': path.as_posix(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'exact_markers': found, 'path_match': named})
result = {'scope': 'Candidate provenance pointers in selected public paths. A text or filename match establishes neither ownership nor release approval.', 'files_screened': len(files), 'matches': matches}
out = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation/price-review-provenance-index.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'artifact': out.as_posix(), 'files_screened': len(files), 'matches': len(matches), 'exact_marker_paths': [item['path'] for item in matches if item['exact_markers']][:20]}))
